WITH dir_sync AS
(
    SELECT table, sum(ProfileEvents['DirectorySync']) AS synced
    FROM system.part_log
    WHERE event_date >= yesterday() AND event_time >= now() - 600
      AND database = currentDatabase() AND event_type = 'NewPart' AND part_name = 'all_1_1_1'

        >= (SELECT synced FROM dir_sync WHERE table = 'detach_fsync_packed_drop') + 3 AS clone_synced,
    (SELECT synced FROM dir_sync WHERE table = 'detach_fsync_packed_proj')
        > (SELECT synced FROM dir_sync WHERE table = 'detach_fsync_packed_on') AS proj_subtree_synced,
    (SELECT synced FROM dir_sync WHERE table = 'detach_fsync_packed_off') = 0 AS off_not_synced,

    initiator.log_comment AS mode,
    sum(part.ProfileEvents['RuntimeFilterGranulesConsidered']) > 0 AS granules_considered,
    sum(part.ProfileEvents['RuntimeFilterGranulesDropped']) > 0 AS granules_dropped,
    -- Guards against the rows passing vacuously: a row that stopped engaging parallel replicas at all - a
    -- changed default, a new bail-out - would keep pruning locally and stay green while testing nothing.
    max(initiator.ProfileEvents['ParallelReplicasUsedCount']) > 0 AS parallel_replicas_engaged,
    -- The initiator's own read, which the aggregates above cannot speak for: a follower pruning its share
    -- satisfies them even if the initiator's read lost its descriptors, which is the regression this fixes.
    -- `RuntimeFilterIndexAnalysisReads` counts a read that reached its pipeline still carrying them, so it
    -- holds whatever the coordinator assigns and whenever the filter becomes ready. The granule counters
    -- cannot stand in for it: they only move once a granule is examined, so a run where the coordinator
    -- leaves the initiator no share, or where its read gets there before the filter, says nothing.
    sumIf(part.ProfileEvents['RuntimeFilterIndexAnalysisReads'], part.is_initial_query) > 0
        AS initiator_read_kept_its_descriptors
FROM system.query_log AS part
INNER JOIN
(
    SELECT query_id, log_comment, ProfileEvents
    FROM system.query_log
    WHERE current_database = currentDatabase() AND is_initial_query AND type = 'QueryFinish'
        AND log_comment IN ('05153_local', '05153_distributed_plan', '05153_parallel_replicas',

WITH
    arrayMap(l -> replaceAll(l, '\t', '    '), splitByChar('\n', description)) AS lines,
    arrayMap(l -> toUInt32(length(l) - length(replaceRegexpOne(l, '^ +', ''))), lines) AS indent,
    arrayMap(l -> match(l, '\S'), lines) AS nonblank,
    arrayCumSum(arrayMap(l -> toUInt8(match(l, '^ *```')), lines)) AS fences_through,
    arrayMap(l -> match(l, '^ *([-*+]|[0-9]+[.)])\s'), lines) AS is_list,
    arrayMap(l -> toUInt32(length(extract(l, '^( *(?:[-*+]|[0-9]+[.)])\s+)'))), lines) AS list_offset,
    -- The lines that start a code block if they are indented far enough relative to their container.
    arrayFilter((i, line_nonblank, prev_nonblank, line_indent, prev_fences_through) ->
            line_nonblank
            AND NOT prev_nonblank                          -- preceded by a blank line
            AND line_indent >= 4
            AND prev_fences_through % 2 = 0,               -- outside a fenced code block
        arrayEnumerate(lines),
        nonblank,
        arrayPushFront(arrayPopBack(nonblank), 1),         -- the first line has no blank line before it
        indent,
        arrayPushFront(arrayPopBack(fences_through), 0)) AS candidates,
    -- The container of each candidate: the nearest preceding non-blank line indented less, 0 at the top level.
    arrayMap(i -> arrayLastIndex((line_nonblank, line_indent) -> line_nonblank AND line_indent < indent[i],
            arraySlice(nonblank, 1, i - 1), arraySlice(indent, 1, i - 1)),
        candidates) AS containers
SELECT name, type
FROM system.documentation
WHERE arrayExists((i, container) ->
        -- top level: any indent of four or more columns is a code block
        container = 0
        -- otherwise: a code block only if indented four columns past the enclosing list content
        OR indent[i] >= if(is_list[container], list_offset[container], indent[container]) + 4,
        candidates, containers)
ORDER BY type, name
